si.t: Singapore P1 Phase & Priority Strategy Mapper 2026
A planning tool to understand P1 registration phases, map school distances, and build a timeline — NOT a guarantee of admission.
• PROFILE — capture your child's details (DOB, address, citizenship, sibling status) for quick reference.
• PHASE MAP — overview of all P1 registration phases (1 to 3), key dates, and what each phase means.
• DISTANCE & PRIORITY — list schools of interest, their distance categories, and planning relevance.
• ACTION PLAN — build a personalised timeline with deadlines, priorities, and status tracking.
STEP 1 · Go to PROFILE and fill in your child's details and residential address.
STEP 2 · Review PHASE MAP to understand which phase applies to you. Use DISTANCE & PRIORITY to shortlist schools.
STEP 3 · Build your ACTION PLAN with key deadlines and track progress.
WHAT IS OFFICIAL vs PLANNING GUIDANCE vs USER INPUT
• Official rules: MOE P1 registration phases, eligibility criteria, and balloting rules (published annually by MOE).
• Planning guidance: typical phase timelines, distance categories (<1km, 1-2km, >2km), and common preparation steps.
• User input: your Profile details, school selections, Action Plan items — entirely controlled by you.

This tool is for planning and organisation only. It does NOT guarantee admission to any school. MOE rules change annually; always verify latest information on the MOE website and individual school websites before registration.

• Exact dates change annually — check MOE P1 Registration website for current year.
• Balloting order: <1km SC > <1km PR > 1-2km SC > 1-2km PR > >2km SC > >2km PR
• Phase 2B volunteer hours must be completed by 30 June of year BEFORE registration.
• Address used for distance is the one on NRIC at registration. 30-month stay rule may apply.
• MOE Kindergarten (MK) priority applies only to MKs within 2km of the primary school.
• Phase 2A covers both alumni association members and school staff (per MOE framework).
